title: Battle of Paardeberg
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Paardeberg", at revision 1370271388, opens: "The Battle of Paardeberg or Perdeberg was a major battle during the Second Anglo-Boer War. It was fought near Paardeberg Drift on the banks of the Modder River in the Orange Free State near Kimberley." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2237713, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1900 battle of the Second Boer War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
